'''Jedi Heritage Matt's Dark Idea''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jedi Heritage]]
* '''Published:''' 7 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Control Station|Dagobah-D-executorcontrolstation.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Control Station
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Executor Control Station Heritag.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

***This is my friend's dark deck. The is up for the weekend, and he doesn't have GPN....yet, so he asked if he could use my name to post his decks....and here they are....This deck is mainly focused on forcefulness, and a little bit on force drain

== Strategy ==

My strategy is to try to get my droids into the droid workshop and force drain while keeping a dominant fleet in space.  I am aware that I do not have

many ground forces and keep those cards to a minimum.
